summary.text: Sam Marty (J. Sam Marty on Ballotpedia) is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 28 who took office on January 14, 2025, after serving in the state House from 2015 to 2023.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary, in which he defeated Ryan Maher, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Marty served in the U.S. Army from 1968 to 1969, and his career experience includes working as a rancher.
Before his election to the Senate, he represented District 28B in the South Dakota House of Representatives.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources and Education committees and is vice chair of the Senate Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee.
He won the 2026 Republican primary with 51.8% of the vote, 2,095 votes to Maher's 1,950.
